title: First Move Friends
summary: Play a guided 4×4 lantern duel with a friend on one screen or two.
user: Casual pairs who want a small browser tile game they learn during the first real match.
smallest_useful_product: A turn-based 4x4 lantern-placement duel with three guided opening moves, a public goal card, shuffled tile order, and quick rematches.
constraints: High-contrast tile states with non-color cues
